fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-02-26, a blue truck bearing registration number TN-45-ZZ-1056 belonging to the complainant was taken from Roja Layout Industrial Area. The time of the incident was given as 22:10 on 2025-02-26. Bharath Prakash submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000118. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Abirami Krishnan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000111, in connection with the events. A further person, Revathi Ammal, a driver, using the number 9000000164, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away from an industrial parking space at night.
fields.Keywords: truck theft, vehicle, night, truck, CCTV, mobile number, suspect, associate
